methodology.scope: All 27 catalog queries; fixed par configuration, no plan selection.
methodology.invocations: One untimed exact execution at SF0.1. SF1/SF10: one warmup and five plain samples; independent untimed counts; one warmup and five profile samples. Any warm/timed execution above ten seconds reduces that mode to its first three samples.
methodology.correctness: Every warm and timed result matches the authored DuckDB SQL as a normalized exact set; DECIMAL trailing-zero normalization only.
methodology.plain_boundary: query::run including query-local construction; excludes loading, canonicalization, comparison and final answer destruction.
methodology.profile_boundary: Setup+build and final evaluation come from the same median-total profile execution, never from plain total. TASKS_BUILD_WALL_TOTAL measures the wall-time union of setup/publication intervals across all Tasks programs in that execution; nested/concurrent intervals count once. Setup+build includes upstream scans, routing and joins needed to publish stores. Final evaluation is profile total minus that union, including boundary/teardown residual. Per-program TASKS_QUERY_WALL spans remain raw diagnostics, not an additive split. Uninstrumented whole-query totals are primary for performance comparisons.
methodology.limitations: Task-local/lazy construction during final evaluation remains there unless it enters an explicit build interval. Ordinary inclusive operator task spans may overlap and exceed root wall time; they are never summed into this split. Parallel setup+build is not identical to default/LE/advised exclusive build (BUILD_EXCLUSIVE_TOTAL) and is not exclusive index insertion. Sequential primitive bag/set agreement is inapplicable to Tasks buffers/canonicalization and is marked unverified; actual counters, exact answers and independent counted operator graph checks are retained.
methodology.timeout: Combined configuration wall budget includes loading, warmup, timed runs and exact checks across plain/counts/profile; never a numeric query timing. Completed exact plain metrics survive later counting/profile timeout; missing phases remain null.
